description: Search term suggestions by economic activity (CNAE), with the description, the family and coverage indicators. Free. Without `q`, it lists the activities with the most registered suppliers. With `q`, it searches by code prefix (`1412`, `1412-6/01`) or by a word of the description. A null `familia` or `termos` means that the CNAE is not in the dictionary yet: an alert by CNPJ does not use it.

q.description: Code prefix (1412) or a word of the description (optional).

name: list_cnaes
title: Activity codes (CNAE)
